verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is an API-first service that runs headlessly by design. It ships official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby and Rust, uses token-based API auth, and supports async long-running operations that the clients handle by blocking until completion. Its docs explicitly recommend isolated per-test namespaces for testing, which fits CI use. missing for 10: no CLI or CI-specific guides (e.g. CI pipeline examples), programmatic API-token provisioning (tokens are created in the dashboard), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
